spec.description: One radar: where it is, its data latency, the status of the radar itself, and its latest performance and calibration reports.

station_id.description: Station identifier, such as `KATX`. `radar.list_stations` returns it as `properties.id`.

reportingHost.description: Monitoring host to report status and latency from. `rdss` is the only one the service knew on 2026-10-01.

host.description: LDM host to measure `latency` at, such as `ldm1`. Without it, `ldm4` on 2026-10-01; a host the service does not know answers a `latency` of nulls.

response.description: The radar, in the GeoJSON feature the API wraps it in. Returned whole: the geometry is the only place the radar's coordinates are.
